verdict.rationale: Docs describe delegating tasks that get implemented, tested, and then reviewed/merged (factory-docs-1, factory-docs-36, factory-docs-37), and Droid integrates with Git workflows and CI/CD via droid exec (factory-docs-2, factory-docs-6, factory-docs-17), implying PR creation is part of the pipeline, but no page explicitly documents an 'auto-open pull request on completion' setting or configuration flag. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic PR/MR creation as a configurable trigger, and any first-party or independent confirmation that a PR is opened without manual action.
